notes: Walking a customisable dog is a pet companion loop, so this is Roleplay & Avatar Sim on the Pet Care preset rather than Animal Sim — the player is the owner, not the animal. There is no town, so I swapped the preset's settlement-claimable for wilderness-open and dropped building-interior with it, which keeps this off the P3 this genre usually carries; the answer's small woodland loop of connected trails is the whole map, one continuous surface. The trails themselves are the circulation option reworded from streets to worn woodland paths. Deciding without a user: nothing to reach or collect was added because wandering is stated to be the entire game, so the trail loops back on itself rather than terminating anywhere, and I kept one trailhead clearing as a gathering spot since walking together is the point.
